jobs.prompt:
Create a finished production reference illustration for Joseon Hunters, a Korean dark-fantasy isometric ARPG. One consistently recognizable adult Korean woman, the tavern hostess who is secretly the Gumiho phase-one boss. Preserve the approved face: narrow amber eyes meeting the viewer with a knowing quietly seductive smile, composed predatory confidence; adult age around 30. Human face, human ears, human hands and human feet. Ordinary worn indigo long-sleeved jeogori, one left shoulder naturally slipped from the existing overlapping neckline, an intact modest inner chest layer, pale stained apron tied around the waist, brown chima opening through natural movement and seams. Copy the approved P1 silhouette and cloth construction. The cloth must look physically wearable: continuous collar, overlapping front panels, connected sleeves, a plausible waist tie and complete skirt; opaque fabric. Worn cuffs and hem, dried blood on fingers, old blood staining at apron and hem, subtle dark corrupted skin at wrists and ankles. She is a dangerous boss rather than an armored noblewoman. Exactly TWO arms, TWO hands, TWO legs, TWO feet. Exactly NINE distinct physical fox tails, naturally rooted in a compact fan at the lower back/sacrum behind the waist, each has one visible distinct tip, dark brown at roots grading to dirty ivory and aged red-brown tips. No extra limbs, no paw feet, no wolf head, no animal legs, no horns, no spell effects. Match the H1 Korean concept-art family: confident drawn contours, restrained painterly matte surfaces, large readable cloth planes, dark navy/brown/ivory palette with amber eyes and restrained blood accents. Neutral dark warm-gray studio background, soft even descriptive light, no dramatic fog hiding anatomy. Full figure entirely inside the image, including all fingertips, feet and tail tips. No captions, symbols, layout frames, montage panels, watermarks, decorative modern lingerie or arbitrary holes cut into fabric. Reference images specify face/costume/pose; do not copy their backgrounds or multiple-panel compositions.

VIEW REQUIREMENT:
One strict orthographic FRONT view, standing neutral A-pose, feet shoulder-width apart, arms lowered 30 degrees away from the body, relaxed open hands, each finger separated. Head upright and eyes toward camera. Let the nine tails fan behind her without covering torso, elbows or feet; their roots are studied in a separate rear drawing. Both legs and bare feet visibly distinct under the natural skirt opening. No action pose. Exact frontal symmetry of camera, body otherwise naturally asymmetrical as approved.
